text.en: Technology can give a disabled person freedom to travel, talk, study and work.

The lesson tells how technology has changed the lives of Alisha and David. David controls an instrument with his eye movements, sends and receives text messages and plays MP3 music on his ECO2 device, and has been chosen to travel to Brazil with the Remix Drama Group for the Olympic opening ceremony.
According to the 2011 Census, 2.21 percent of India's population is disabled, and attitudes are often the greatest barrier. Indian innovations such as Lechal shoes by Krispian Lawrence use GPS and Bluetooth to help the visually impaired navigate.
Words to learn: disabled, assistive, innovation, navigate and barrier. This is an informative, report-style text with facts and examples.
